statements.t: This, together with previously reported biomarker evidence of target engagement, further validates the disease-modifying hypothesis underpinning our development strategy for rexaceract in PD.

We continue to believe rexaceract has the potential to shift the treatment paradigm beyond symptom management, and we look forward to achieving additional potential clinical and regulatory milestones throughout the remainder of the year.”

Mack continued, “As we approach the start of the Phase 2 clinical trial of rexaceract , which we expect to initiate during Q1 2027 after confirming updates to our trial design during Q4 2026, we plan to select an initial therapeutic indication to advance GT-04686 into the clinic.

We believe advancing a second allosteric small molecule candidate into clinical development is a milestone that will help position us for our next phase of growth as we build a differentiated GCase-targeting platform with the potential to unlock multiple therapeutic opportunities.”
